name: Get Sample Mitre Attack Techniques
description: Get the MITRE ATT&CK techniques VMRay observed for a sample — costs no quota.

sample_id.description: VMRay sample ID — e.g. the `sample_ids` of Get Submission Result or Get Samples By Hash.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

submission_id.description: VMRay submission ID — e.g. the `submission_ids` of Get Submission Result. It is resolved to its sample with one GET /submission/{id}. Used when `sample_id` is empty.
submission_id.title: Submission ID

found.description: True when VMRay returned at least one technique.
found.title: Found

sample_id.description: The sample the data belongs to.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

technique_ids.description: The ATT&CK technique IDs found in the techniques (e.g. T1055), in order.
technique_ids.title: Technique IDs

techniques.description: The techniques exactly as VMRay returns them.
techniques.title: Techniques
